headline: This law extends for four more years the requirement that the Postal Service sell a special breast cancer research stamp to raise money for research.
what_it_does: The Postal Service must keep offering a special first-class stamp that costs more than the regular stamp. The extra money raised goes to breast cancer research. The law extends this program through December 31, 2019. Agencies that receive the money must spend it on breast cancer research.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy and mail first-class letters
who_it_affects.how: They can choose to pay the higher price for the special breast cancer research stamp, which raises money for research.

who_it_affects.group: Breast cancer researchers and research agencies
who_it_affects.how: They can receive funds from the stamp sales, but the money must be used only for breast cancer research.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 11, 2015, and the stamp program is extended through December 31, 2019.
